description.value:
The liquid is the colour of a sunrise seen through closed eyes, and it is warm in the bottle.

You can drink this potion as a reaction when damage would reduce you to 0 hit points. Instead, you rise with hit points equal to your hit point maximum, the damage is otherwise ignored, and you are no longer charmed, frightened, paralyzed, poisoned or stunned.

For the next minute, you have resistance to all damage. If damage reduces you to 0 hit points during that minute, you make a Constitution saving throw with a DC of 5 + the damage taken; on a success, you drop to 1 hit point instead. When the minute ends, you gain one level of exhaustion for each of these saving throws you succeeded on.

Midi-QOL

A reaction offered when incoming damage is at least your current hit points plus temporary hit points (before resistances). The Second Breath effect lasts 1 minute and uses an isDamaged macro, which rolls the saving throws; the exhaustion is applied when it ends.

activation.condition: When damage would reduce you to 0 hit points

effects.name: Second Breath
effects.description: Resistance to all damage. Damage that would drop you to 0 calls for a Constitution save (DC 5 + damage): on a success you drop to 1 instead. A level of exhaustion for each such save when this ends.
